preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Attacker must hold some 1SHIBA tokens to demonstrate fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() with extremely high values (e.g., 99). Then perform token transfers to trigger fee collection. The high fees will cause significant token deductions from users, with portions converted to BNB and sent to the marketing address (which the owner could control) or added to liquidity where the owner receives LP tokens. The owner can also exclude themselves from fees using excludeFromFee() to avoid paying the high fees.
